title: FLAWS: A Benchmark for Error Identification and Localization in Scientific Papers
abstract: arXiv:2511.21843v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The identification and localization of errors is a core task in peer review, yet the exponential growth of scientific output has made it increasingly difficult for human reviewers to reliably detect errors given the limited pool of experts. Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have sparked interest in their potential to support such evaluation tasks, from academic peer review to automated scientific assessment. However, despite the growing use of LLMs in review systems, their capabilities to pinpoint errors remain underexplored. In this work, we introduce Fault Localization Across Writing in Science (FLAWS), an automated benchmark consisting of 713 paper-error pairs designed to evaluate how effectively LLMs detect errors that undermine key claims in research papers. We construct the benchmark by systematically inserting claim-invalidating errors into peer-reviewed papers using LLMs, paired with an automated evaluation metr

translated_title: FLAWS：科学论文中错误识别与定位的基准测试
translated_abstract: 错误的识别与定位是同行评审中的一项核心任务，然而科学产出的指数级增长，加之专家资源有限，使得人类评审者越来越难以可靠地检测出错误。大语言模型（LLM）的最新进展激发了人们对其在这类评估任务中潜力的兴趣，涵盖从学术同行评审到自动化科学评估等应用。然而，尽管LLM在评审系统中的应用日益增多，其精确定位错误的能力却仍未得到充分探索。在本工作中，我们提出了科学写作中的错误定位基准FLAWS（Fault Localization Across Writing in Science），这是一个包含713个论文-错误对的自动化基准，旨在评估LLM检测那些破坏研究论文关键论断的错误的有效性。我们通过利用LLM系统性地在经同行评审的论文中插入使论断失效的错误来构建该基准，并配套了自动化的评估指标。
tldr: 该论文提出了FLAWS基准，通过在同行评审论文中系统性插入破坏关键论断的错误，构建了713个论文-错误对，以自动化评估大语言模型检测和定位科学论文中错误的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces FLAWS, an automated benchmark of 713 paper-error pairs constructed by systematically inserting claim-invalidating errors into peer-reviewed papers, to evaluate how effectively LLMs detect and localize errors that undermine key claims in scientific papers.
